item.title: Show HN: Field Guide to SF Slang
item.summary: A friend of mine just moved to San Francisco and was completely lost in our vocab. So I built this for her and everyone like her: sfisms.org The field guide to SF vernacular. Got an ism? Pitch it and an agent adds it after expert review by our panel :) Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49394412 Points: 1 # Comments: 0
